Hello to all my wonderful Beta Readers and fans. As some of you know, Carol and I have spent the last several months selling our house in Phoenix, shipping all our furniture and belongings to Georgetown, Texas, searching for and buying a new home in Georgetown, and are now in the throws of moving furniture and unpacking endless boxes… but the end is finally in sight.

Today, I just published my new website… still at https://thesecondship.net.

Now that I have a desk again and am finally getting settled in, I will be back, hard at work on the newly renamed … Unpunished – Book Two of The Rho Agenda Singularity series. We will see how fast I can get this baby knocked out.

Enjoy the new look and functionality of the site.

All the best from Texas,

Richard
